review.use_summary: Used MVP Release 4 genotypes whose core processing imputed against TOPMed using SHAPEIT4 4.1.3 and Minimac4 before ancestry-specific GWAS/TWAS genotype QC.
review.implementation_scope_note: The MVP data core supplied the imputed genotypes. Release 4 is the MVP data release; 4.1.3 is the SHAPEIT4 version, and EIGENSOFT6 is separate; none specifies a Minimac patch release. TOPMed panel access, phasing, ancestry assignment, QC and GReX estimation are separate.

review.use_summary: The 23andMe data pipeline phased array genotypes using Finch or Eagle2, then imputed with Minimac3 using a combined 1000 Genomes Phase III/UK10K reference described on GRCh38 before ancestry-stratified Parkinson disease association.
review.implementation_scope_note: Minimac3 is the reported family; do not silently substitute Minimac4. The proprietary cohort pipeline, combined reference construction, prephasing and logistic association are separate. No Minimac3 patch release or fitting options are stated.

review.use_summary: Imputed the screening cohort through a local Michigan Imputation Server 1.5.7 using Eagle2, Minimac4 and 1000G Phase3 v5; MGB Biobank batches were separately imputed through the server with that reference.
review.implementation_scope_note: Server 1.5.7 is not a Minimac release. Screening post-imputation MAF filtering and batch intersection/QC are separate. The UKBB paragraph instead describes SHAPEIT/IMPUTE2 but labels its QC score Minimac r2<0.4; retain this attribution tension and do not invent an additional Minimac run or repair the stated MAC inequality.

review.use_summary: Received chromosome-wise GRCh37 VCF genotypes for1, 980 Tarkin participants previously imputed using Minimac3 without indels, and performed subsequent biallelic selection, BCFtools naming and PLINK2 sample/variant QC.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is receipt/reuse of already imputed genotypes, not evidence of a new Minimac execution in this study. The reference panel, Minimac3 patch release and fitting settings are unstated; the separate QMDiab imputation description does not supply them.

review.use_summary: Prephased with Eagle2 2.4.1 and imputed using Minimac4 1.0.2 against1000 Genomes Phase3 v5 ALL; BBJ1-12K/BBJ2-42K also used the GRCh38 high-coverage 1000 Genomes panel. Chromosome X was phased and imputed separately in men and women; association excluded R2 < 0.3.
review.implementation_scope_note: Retain the historical executable1.0.2 and separate panel/build analyses. Male/female and chromosome X/PAR ploidy choices must be explicit; do not infer them from sex labels or force diploid calls. Eagle2 is separate. The R2 filter is not a P-value or a measured per-person genotype accuracy.

review.use_summary: Imputed developmental-brain genotypes to TOPMed Freeze5 using Minimac4 and Eagle 2.4, retaining biallelic rsID SNPs with R2 > 0.8. Adult-brain array batches were sent to the TOPMed server, phased with Eagle 2.4 and imputed with Minimac4/TOPMed before cross-array intersection and further QC.
review.implementation_scope_note: TOPMed Freeze5 is a panel edition, not a Minimac release. Developmental and adult/batch workflows remain distinct; their exact panel resources, phasing, MAF/HWE/missingness QC, HapMap3 selection and TWAS model training are not supplied by imputation alone. Preserve strict R2 > 0.8.

review.use_summary: MVP biallelic SNPs were imputed using Minimac4 with the African Genome Resources panel; indels/complex variants were imputed independently with 1000 Genomes Phase3 then merged. Separately, iPSYCH used Eagle 2.3.5/Minimac and HRC v1.0 in a phased imputation pipeline.
review.implementation_scope_note: Do not transfer the MVP Minimac4 label to the unversioned iPSYCH Minimac run. The statement does not identify the indel imputer or executable patches. Panel-specific merging, batch handling, best-guess genotype conversion and post-imputation cohort-specific filters are distinct.

review.use_summary: Estimated haplotypes using SHAPEIT4 and imputed untyped variants using Minimac4 with an in-house Japanese whole-genome reference panel of 11, 754 individuals.
review.implementation_scope_note: The 11, 754 count belongs to the reference panel. No Minimac patch release, compression format or fitted options are stated. SHAPEIT4 phasing and access/preparation of the private reference are separate; no reference download or participant upload is implied.

review.use_summary: Cohort genotype imputation used TOPMed Imputation Server 1.7.3 and a TOPMed reference through Minimac4; the paper also identifies ROSMAP pre-imputed genotypes received from collaborators. Subsequent filtering removed MAF < 0.1% and imputation quality < 0.8 variants.
review.implementation_scope_note: Server 1.7.3 is not the Minimac release. Preserve the distinction between cohort imputation and received ROSMAP data; the source does not give a Minimac patch or exact reference freeze. BCFtools/SAMtools/PLINK/R processing and downstream GWAS are separate.

review.use_summary: Separately prephased BBJ first cohort with SHAPEIT2 2.837 and BBJ second/NCGG cohorts with EAGLE2 2.39, then performed genome-wide imputation using Minimac4 1.0.0 after sample overlap and variant concordance/QC exclusions.
review.implementation_scope_note: Retain the historical 1.0.0 executable and cohort-specific phasing versions; do not label modern 4.1.6 as its reproduction. Reference-panel construction, overlap removal, palindromic exclusion and QC are separate; this paragraph does not name a specific panel.

review.use_summary: Used Michigan Imputation Server/Eagle 2.4/Minimac4 with HRC r1.1 (2016) for KOBS genotype imputation after allele/duplicate checks; separate METSIM data usedTOPMed server/Eagle 2.4/Minimac4 with TOPMed r2. Post-imputation QC excluded R2 < 0.3.
review.implementation_scope_note: Keep HRC and TOPMed panel/version pipelines distinct. Server-managed allele switches/strand flips are not implicit local corrections. The Minimac patch release is unstated; downstream demultiplexing, relatedness/HWE QC and association remain separate.

review.use_summary: OneK1K cohort data were imputed through Michigan Imputation Server/Minimac4 with HRC. The study separately imputed chromosome X non-PAR and PAR1/PAR2 segments through that server; Y haplogroup assignment used yhaplo instead of genotype imputation.
review.implementation_scope_note: Preserve the reuse of previously described cohort genotypes and the separate regionalX analysis. PAR/non-PAR and per-sample haploid/diploid interpretation must be explicitly declared; do not infer genome build from the quoted coordinates or silently correct the source description of male non-PAR Y. Y haplogroup assignment is a different tool, not Minimac imputation. No Minimac patch release stated.

review.use_summary: Imputed three cohorts separately through Michigan server using Minimac4, HRC/GRCh37, Eagle 2.4, EUR population and an imputation rsq filter 0.3; cohortI was lifted from hg18 to hg19 beforehand.
review.implementation_scope_note: The server imputation filter 0.3 is stated without an explicit strict/inclusive boundary; do not invent one. HRC edition and Minimac patch release are unstated. LiftOver, server panel/population selection and post-imputation multiallelic/palindromic filtering are separate; unequal cohort marker counts reflect the described input arrays.
